title.suggested: Tom Allen Advertises Free Concerts at 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat carried a sporting note advertising Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, with free concerts every evening and the best singers in the city engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, June 21, 1890, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen's saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, advertised free concerts every evening

notes: Clipping also contains unrelated sporting notes above and below the Allen item; only the Allen notice matters.
